census-baseline: Write counters are compared with the snapshot taken {{at}} UTC.
census-card-description: Every table with its rows and signs of writes, and every game and app with its 30-day actives. Live, plus one stored snapshot a month.
census-counters-never-reset: Counters were never reset, so their start is unknown.
census-description: Every table and every product, with the signs of use the database keeps.
census-no-baseline: No stored snapshot is {{days}} days old yet, so most tables without a timestamp column read "unknown".
census-no-last-write: Postgres does not record when a table was last written. Every column here is an indirect sign of use; the notes under the list say what each one is.
census-note-actives: Actives are distinct signed-in users in the last {{days}} days. Signed-out visitors are not counted anywhere.
census-note-autoanalyze: Autoanalyze is when autovacuum last analysed the table. It does that only after enough rows changed, so a recent date means recent writes; an old or empty one means little.
census-note-index-reads: Index reads is index scans since the counters started. Sequential scans are left out because a backup makes one per table. Reading a newest row through an index adds one index read each time the census runs.
census-note-newest-row: Newest row is the largest updatedAt or createdAt, in UTC. It is read only where that is cheap: through an index on the column, or by scanning a table of at most {{kb}} kB. A larger table without such an index says "not read". It dates the last insert or Prisma update; a delete never shows.
census-note-no-last-write: Postgres does not record when a table was last written. Nothing here is a last-write time; each column is one indirect sign.
census-note-not-measured: An off-site or unlisted product sends no heartbeat. Its zero means "not measured", and it is never marked quiet.
census-note-playtime: Playtime counts users with a heartbeat on the product's pages, by UTC day. History counts users whose history holds a visit to it. The total counts each user once.
census-note-rows: Rows is the planner's estimate of live rows, not a count.
census-note-verdict-snapshots: Active: the newest row or an autoanalyze is inside {{days}} days, or the counters started inside them and show writes. Then, once a stored snapshot is {{days}} days old, the write counter decides: moved since that snapshot is active, unmoved is quiet. Without one, quiet means the counters cover all {{days}} days and show no write, or the newest row is older. Unknown: none of these can be shown.
census-note-writes: Writes is rows inserted, updated and deleted since the counters started. A reset or a crash restarts them, so read it with the start time above.
census-replace-body: One snapshot is kept per month. Taking one now overwrites the one stored for this month.
census-snapshot-failed: The snapshot was not saved. Wait a few minutes and try again.
census-taken-cron: Stored by the monthly job. Taken {{at}} UTC.
census-taken-manual: Stored by an admin. Taken {{at}} UTC.
census-unavailable-hint: Reload the page. If it keeps failing, the database statistics could not be read.
confirm-grant-admin: Are you sure you want to grant Admin privileges to this user? They will have full access to the database.
